title: Recursive Governance: A Graph-Theoretic Framework for Risk Propagation and Drift Detection in Agentic AI Systems
summary: As financial institutions transition from traditional predictive models to autonomous agentic systems, the static model inventory requirements of traditional model risk management (MRM) face structural obsolescence. This paper proposes a dynamic Inventory-as-Code (IaC) governance loop that treats the model inventory as a living architectural component rather than a periodic documentation artifact.
